tasks.title: Unified opt-in categorical diagnostics
scope: Categories Game detection, Capture/Encoder, Audio, Library/index, Settings, Editor, Updater, General; timestamps, severity (errors-only), category/all, search, copy/export, bounded history, visible auto-refresh. Separate timing sampling vs verbose event logging. Both default OFF; warn for testing/CPU/memory/disk use.

OFF: no eager formatted strings, event allocation, timing, verbose queue/buffer/worker/timer/disk writes. Cheap early branch only; no literal-zero-instructions promise. Release optional resources on disable. ON: bounded batched queue/UI, throttled IO, no frame spam, privacy-safe export. Preserve appropriate essential crash/error reporting separately; do not merely hide existing worker output.

Existing Util.cs Log uses BlockingCollection (10,000), writer thread, timestamped messages, batches to quickclip.log, rotates >2MB at startup. Audit managed and native call sites. Wave 1 timing panel is NOT this implementation. Benchmark off baseline/disabled vs enabled including CPU, allocated bytes, memory, disk IO and FPS.
acceptance: Off path only cheap guard/essential failures; no optional allocation/formatting/worker/timer/queue/disk; enabled bounded batched UI and safe export, categories/severity/search; separate timing toggle. OFF/ON benchmark incl allocations, CPU, IO/FPS.
